missions.title: Counting Market
missions.topic: One or more · there is and there are
missions.subtitle: Count the village supplies
missions.guide: Tap a word block. Count the supplies for the village!
missions.reminder: Use There is for one thing. Use There are for two or more.

tasks.prompt: One cap is here. There ___ a cap.
tasks.hint: One cap: say There is a cap.
tasks.explain: There is tells us about one cap.

tasks.prompt: Two shoes are here. There ___ two shoes.
tasks.hint: Two shoes: say There are two shoes.
tasks.explain: There are tells us about more than one shoe.

tasks.prompt: One parrot is in the room. ___ a parrot.
tasks.hint: There's means There is.
tasks.explain: There's a parrot tells us about one parrot.

tasks.prompt: We want to count the hats. How ___ hats are there?
tasks.hint: Ask How many? to count things.
tasks.explain: How many hats are there? asks for the number of hats.

tasks.prompt: Count the cars: car, car, car. There are ___ cars.
tasks.hint: Count each car: one, two, three.
tasks.explain: There are three cars. Cars is the word for more than one car.

missions.title: Weekend Bridge
missions.subtitle: Ask about free time
missions.guide: Tap a word block. Ask about free time to build the bridge!
missions.reminder: Do you? asks about a routine. Reply Yes, I do or No, I don't.

tasks.prompt: You play tennis on Sundays. Do you play tennis on Sundays? Yes, I ___.
tasks.hint: You play tennis. Answer Yes, I do.
tasks.explain: Yes, I do answers the question about your routine.

tasks.prompt: You do not watch TV on Mondays. Do you watch TV on Mondays? No, I ___.
tasks.hint: You do not watch TV. Answer No, I don't.
tasks.explain: No, I don't tells us that you do not do this activity.

tasks.prompt: Complete the routine question: ___ you play football on Saturdays?
tasks.full: Do you play football on Saturdays?
tasks.hint: Start the question with Do you.
tasks.explain: Do you play football on Saturdays? asks about a routine.

tasks.prompt: You ride a bike at the weekend. Do you ride a bike at the weekend? Yes, I ___.
tasks.hint: You ride a bike. Answer Yes, I do.
tasks.explain: Yes, I do means that this is your weekend activity.

tasks.prompt: You do not play the piano on Fridays. Do you play the piano on Fridays? ___
tasks.hint: You do not play the piano. Choose No, I don't.
tasks.explain: No, I don't matches the routine in the clue.

missions.title: Free-time Train
missions.topic: I play · on days of the week
missions.subtitle: Make a free-time plan
missions.guide: Tap the word carriages in order. Tell a friend your plan!
missions.reminder: Use on with a day. Start your sentence with I.

tasks.prompt: You play football every Monday. Make your sentence. Start with I.
tasks.hint: Start with I play. Add football on Mondays.
tasks.explain: I play football on Mondays tells us your weekly activity.

tasks.prompt: You watch TV every Friday. Make your sentence. Start with I.
tasks.hint: Start with I watch. Add TV on Fridays.
tasks.explain: On Fridays tells us when you watch TV.

tasks.prompt: You ride a bike every Sunday. Make your sentence. Start with I.
tasks.answer: I ride a bike on Sundays.
tasks.full: I ride a bike on Sundays.
tasks.hint: Start with I ride. Add a bike on Sundays.
tasks.explain: I ride a bike on Sundays tells us your weekly activity.

tasks.prompt: You play tennis every Tuesday. Make your sentence. Start with I.
tasks.hint: Start with I play. Add tennis on Tuesdays.
tasks.explain: On Tuesdays tells us when you play tennis.

tasks.prompt: You play the piano every Saturday. Make your sentence. Start with I.
tasks.answer: I play the piano on Saturdays.
tasks.full: I play the piano on Saturdays.
tasks.hint: Start with I play. Add the piano on Saturdays.
tasks.explain: I play the piano on Saturdays tells us your weekly activity.

missions.title: Clothes River
missions.subtitle: Dress for the journey
missions.guide: Put the word blocks in order. Describe the clothes to launch a boat!
missions.reminder: Say is wearing to tell us about clothes someone has on now.

tasks.prompt: Amir has a red cap on. Describe his clothes. Start with Amir.
tasks.answer: Amir is wearing a red cap.
tasks.full: Amir is wearing a red cap.
tasks.hint: Start with Amir is wearing. Add a red cap.
tasks.explain: Amir is wearing a red cap tells us what he has on now.

tasks.prompt: Hana has a blue jacket on. Describe her clothes. Start with Hana.
tasks.answer: Hana is wearing a blue jacket.
tasks.full: Hana is wearing a blue jacket.
tasks.hint: Start with Hana is wearing. Add a blue jacket.
tasks.explain: Hana is wearing a blue jacket tells us about her clothes.

tasks.prompt: A girl has a green skirt on. Describe her clothes. Start with She.
tasks.answer: She is wearing a green skirt.
tasks.full: She is wearing a green skirt.
tasks.hint: Start with She is wearing. Add a green skirt.
tasks.explain: She is wearing a green skirt tells us what the girl has on.

tasks.prompt: A boy has blue shoes on. Describe his clothes. Start with He.
tasks.hint: Start with He is wearing. Add blue shoes.
tasks.explain: He is wearing blue shoes tells us what the boy has on.

tasks.prompt: Mia has a warm sweater on. Describe her clothes. Start with Mia.
tasks.answer: Mia is wearing a warm sweater.
tasks.full: Mia is wearing a warm sweater.
tasks.hint: Start with Mia is wearing. Add a warm sweater.
tasks.explain: Mia is wearing a warm sweater tells us about her clothes.

missions.title: Ability Mine
missions.subtitle: Discover what friends can do
missions.guide: Read the clue. Tap a word block to find an ability gem!
missions.reminder: Can means able to do it. Can't means not able to do it.

tasks.prompt: Dan can swim. Dan says: I ___ swim.
tasks.hint: Dan can swim. Choose can.
tasks.explain: I can swim tells us that Dan is able to swim.

tasks.prompt: The robot cannot fly. It says: I ___ fly.
tasks.hint: Cannot and can't mean the same thing.
tasks.explain: I can't fly tells us that the robot is not able to fly.

tasks.prompt: Mia can skip. She ___ skip.
tasks.hint: Mia is able to skip. Choose can.
tasks.explain: She can skip tells us about Mia's ability.

tasks.prompt: Ben can run. Can you run, Ben? Yes, I ___.
tasks.hint: Ben can run. Answer Yes, I can.
tasks.explain: Yes, I can answers the question about running.

tasks.prompt: Hana cannot dance. Can you dance, Hana? No, I ___.
tasks.hint: Hana cannot dance. Answer No, I can't.
tasks.explain: No, I can't tells us that Hana is not able to dance.

missions.title: Dressing Portal
missions.subtitle: Choose clothes for the trip
missions.guide: Tap a word portal. Choose words for one item or more!
missions.reminder: Use this with one cap. Use these with shoes or socks.

tasks.prompt: One cap is here. Do you like ___ cap?
tasks.hint: One cap: use this cap.
tasks.explain: This cap means one cap.

tasks.prompt: Two shoes are here. Do you like ___ shoes?
tasks.hint: Two shoes: use these shoes.
tasks.explain: These shoes means more than one shoe.

tasks.prompt: I like these socks. Do you like these socks? Yes, I ___.
tasks.hint: You like the socks. Answer Yes, I do.
tasks.explain: Yes, I do tells us that you like the socks.

tasks.prompt: I do not like this hat. Do you like this hat? No, I ___.
tasks.hint: You do not like the hat. Answer No, I don't.
tasks.explain: No, I don't tells us that you do not like the hat.

tasks.prompt: Ali is wearing a blue jacket. Is he wearing a blue jacket? Yes, he ___.
tasks.hint: The blue jacket matches. Answer Yes, he is.
tasks.explain: Yes, he is confirms that Ali is wearing a blue jacket.

missions.title: Lost-and-Found Hideout
missions.subtitle: Find the missing things
missions.guide: Read the clue. Tap the words to find the missing things!
missions.reminder: Ask Where's? for one thing. Ask Where are? for more than one.

tasks.prompt: One book is in the bag. ___ the book?
tasks.hint: One book: ask Where's the book?
tasks.explain: Where's means Where is. Use it to ask about one book.

tasks.prompt: Two hats are in the box. ___ the hats?
tasks.hint: Two hats: ask Where are the hats?
tasks.explain: Where are asks about the place of more than one hat.

tasks.prompt: Where's the cap? The cap is in the bag. ___ in the bag.
tasks.hint: One cap: say It's in the bag.
tasks.explain: It's means It is. It takes the place of the cap.

tasks.prompt: Where are the shoes? The shoes are in the box. ___ in the box.
tasks.hint: Two shoes: say They're in the box.
tasks.explain: They're means They are. They takes the place of the shoes.

tasks.prompt: The map is inside the bag. The map is ___ the bag.
tasks.full: The map is in the bag.
tasks.hint: Inside means in.
tasks.explain: In the bag means inside the bag.

missions.title: Beach Castle
missions.subtitle: Make a plan with friends
missions.guide: Read the clue. Tap a suggestion or reply to light the castle!
missions.reminder: Let's suggests an activity together. Say Good idea when you like the plan.

tasks.prompt: Choose the word to make a suggestion: ___ read a book.
tasks.hint: Start your suggestion with Let's.
tasks.explain: Let's read a book suggests reading together.

tasks.prompt: Choose the activity that uses a camera: Let's ___.
tasks.hint: A camera helps us take a photo.
tasks.explain: Let's take a photo suggests an activity with a camera.

tasks.prompt: Your friend says, Let's play tennis. You like the idea. Say: ___
tasks.hint: You like the plan. Say Good idea.
tasks.explain: Good idea tells your friend that you like the suggestion.

tasks.prompt: Your friend says, Let's dance. You do not want to dance. Say: ___
tasks.hint: You do not want to dance. Say Sorry, I don't want to.
tasks.explain: Sorry, I don't want to politely says that you do not want this activity.

tasks.prompt: Choose the activity that uses paper and paints: Let's ___.
tasks.hint: Use paper and paints to paint a picture.
tasks.explain: Let's paint a picture suggests an activity with paper and paints.

rules: There is one ... · There are two ...
Use is for one thing. Use are for two or more.
There is a cap. There are two shoes.
Do you ...? · Yes, I do. · No, I don't.
Use these words to ask and answer about a routine.
Do you play tennis on Sundays? Yes, I do.
Use on with a day to tell a friend when you do an activity.
I ride a bike on Sundays.
He is wearing ... · She is wearing ...
Wearing tells us about clothes someone has on now.
She is wearing a green skirt.
Can means able to do it. Cannot and can't mean the same thing.
I can swim. I can't fly.
Use this with one item. Use these with more than one item.
Do you like this cap? Do you like these shoes?
Use It's for one thing. Use They're for more than one. In means inside.
Where are the shoes? They're in the box.
Use Let's to suggest an activity together. Say Good idea when you like the plan.
Let's paint a picture. Good idea.
